description: A closure that clears a captured field escapes through the table it is stored in: once an opaque sink receives the container the closure is reachable and may run at or after that call, so a later string-typed read of the captured field must be diagnosed. soundness/opaque-callback-capture pins the direct-argument form; this pins the transitive form and its contrast arm, where the container never leaves the function and the flow narrowing on the field survives.
